subject: Game Theory
title: Combinatorial Auctions
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Combinatorial Auctions.

hook.text: What if the value of items depends on which others you win? A radio license in LA plus NY is worth more together.

buildup.text: Combinatorial auctions let bidders bid on bundles, not just individual items.

discovery.text: This captures synergies. Airlines bid on gate bundles. Advertisers bid on time-slot packages.

twist.text: The complexity explodes: with 10 items, there are over 1,000 possible bundles to evaluate.

climax.text: Solving combinatorial auctions requires sophisticated algorithms. Simple bidding won't cut it.

punchline.text: Bundles are worth more than the sum.

quiz.question: What advantage do combinatorial auctions offer?
